answer: A fresh key finds no haven of borrowed standing on PoA: weight comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts a key has sealed on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus. That record bends like willow yet cannot be minted, bought, or handed to a clone, so a sybil swarm is just a plume of empty identities, each forced to grade its own way up from zero. M fakes repay M times the honest judgment labor; the sybil bill stays linear in identities.
